"""Build support/CR-406.json: REQUEST from issue trial-w16 plus its computed
protocol 2 response from main.py."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

request = {
    "command": "accepted",
    "protocol": "2",
    "receipts": [
        {"record_id": "C-3", "account_id": "A", "delivery_id": "same",
         "occurred_at": "2026-04-01T05:00:00-04:00", "payload": "payload:C-3"},
        {"record_id": "C-1", "account_id": "B", "delivery_id": "same",
         "occurred_at": "2026-04-01T10:00:00Z", "payload": "payload:C-1"},
        {"record_id": "C-2", "account_id": "A", "delivery_id": "same",
         "occurred_at": "2026-04-01T12:00:00+02:00", "payload": "payload:C-2"},
    ],
}

proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "main.py"], input=json.dumps(request),
                      capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=5)
response = json.loads(proc.stdout)

with open("support/CR-406.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump({"request": request, "response": response}, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")

print("computed response:", json.dumps(response, indent=2))
